name: Gabriel Attal
role: Deputy for Hauts-de-Seine's 10th constituency; President of the Renaissance group in the National Assembly; General Secretary of Renaissance
bio: Gabriel Attal is a French politician who was Prime Minister of France from 9 January to 5 September 2024, the youngest holder of the office in the Fifth Republic. A Socialist Party member until 2016, he joined Emmanuel Macron's movement and was elected deputy for Hauts-de-Seine's 10th constituency in 2017, then served as spokesperson of La République En Marche, Secretary of State for Education and Youth (2018–2020), Government Spokesperson (2020–2022), Minister of Public Action and Accounts (2022–2023) and Minister of National Education and Youth (2023–2024). His premiership was cut short by the dissolution of the National Assembly in June 2024: he offered his resignation on 8 July 2024, stayed on as caretaker, and handed over to Michel Barnier on 5 September 2024, saying he regretted having had only eight months to deliver his programme. As of October 2026 he leads the Renaissance group in the National Assembly and has been the party's General Secretary since December 2024.
